definitions.explanation: A person who conducts scientific research or works in a scientific field.

examples.japanese: {科学者|かがくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a scientist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{偉大|いだい}→偉大：01798_idai⟧な{科学者|かがくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A great scientist made a new discovery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{科学者|かがくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: Scientists from around the world are working on solving this problem.

notes:
A person who studies or works in the natural sciences. {科学者|かがくしゃ} covers scientists broadly, from physicists to biologists, and is the standard general term.

COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧ (science) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). The ～⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ suffix indicates a person who practices or specializes in something.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧ — science
- ⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧ — researcher
- ⟦{学者|がくしゃ}→学者：02544_gakusha⟧ — scholar; academic

CAUTION — HOMOPHONES:
- {科学者|かがくしゃ} — scientist (from ⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧, science)
- {化学者|かがくしゃ} — chemist (from ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧, chemistry)
- In speech, ⟦{化学|かがく}→化学：05336_kagaku_chem⟧ is sometimes pronounced ばけがく to avoid confusion
